For both datasets, following previous studies on ambiguous QA , we mainly adopt F1-based metric. Specifically, for the short-form QA dataset (SituatedQA) we measure F1 based on the precision and recall between the ground-truth answers and the generated responses. Given ASQA is the long-form QA dataset, following , we use Disambig-F1 (D-F1), which assesses the factual accuracy of long-form responses, instead of F1.
automatic_metrics: DR (geometric mean of D-F1 and ROUGE-L)
